senses.gloss:
ITA-9.6.22 vivaraṇakarma विवरणकर्म
Dilatation
A procedure to widen a tract or orifice for diagnostic and/or therapeutic purposes.

ITA-9.9.43 vivarṇaretodoṣaḥ विवर्णरे तोदोषः
Discoloured semen
Semen disorder characterized by its abnormal colour.

ITA-9.6.21 vivartanakarma विवर्तनकर्म
Twisting movement
A special type of twisting movement required to disimpact or extract a foreign body.

ITA-5.55.4 vivartita-sandhimuktam विवर्तित-सन्धिमुक्तम्
Dislocation with lateral displacement
A lateral dislocation of a joint characterized by lateral displacement of the joint; deformity; pain.

ITA-9.4.36 vivāhasaMskāra विवाहसंस्कारः
Marriage ceremony
A ceremony marking the beginning of married life.

ITA-9.4.41 vivṛtadantaḥ विवृतदन्तः
A kind of abnormal dentition
An abnormal type of dentition presenting as an outward protrusion of teeth with malocclusion and incomplete closure of lips.

ITA-5.62.5 vivṛtā विवृता
Papules resembling a ripe fig
A disorder characterized by lesion resembling a ripe fig fruit; intense burning sensation; lesion with wide opening; roundshaped; fever.

ITA-1.9.3.3.29 vivekaḥ विवेकः
Discrimination
The ability to distinguish and classify things according to their absolute properties.
